hard_constraints: dissonance is not automatic guilt or manipulation
risk and discovery channels remain separate
name: Dissonance Risk & Discovery Engine v179

policies.dissonance_as_risk: treats high dissonance as direct risk and reduces authority
policies.dissonance_probe: uses dissonance only to trigger targeted probes
policies.drde: classifies dissonance into risk/model-error/discovery channels before updating authority
policies.ignore_dissonance: acts from current model without explicit dissonance handling
